fug.definition: n. (British informal) an airless smoky smelly atmosphere
fug.translation:
n. 闷浊空气
vi. 呆在闷室中
vt. 使闷热

fugacious.definition: s lasting a very short time
fugacious.translation:
a. 短暂的, 易逃逸的, 难捕捉的, 易挥发的, 无常的
[医] 暂时的, 易变的, 开足即谢的, 一现的(花)

fugacity.definition:
n. the tendency of a gas to expand or escape
n. the lack of enduring qualities (used chiefly of plant parts)
fugacity.translation:
n. 短暂, 不稳定, 挥发性, 发散性
[化] 逸性; 逸度; 有效压力

fugal.definition: a. of or relating to or in the style of a musical fugue

fugate.translation: n. 不严格遵守形式的赋格曲

fugato.definition:
a. in the gugue style, but not strictly like a fugue.
n. A composition resembling a fugue.

fugger.translation: n. (Fugger)人名；(意)富杰尔；(德)富格尔

fuggers.translation: (fugger 的复数) n. (Fugger)人名；(意)富杰尔；(德)富格尔

fuggier.definition:
comparative of fuggy
s. (British informal) poorly ventilated
fuggier.translation: (fuggy 的比较级) a. 闷气的, 闷热的

fuggles.translation: (fuggle 的复数)  [人名] 法格尔

fuggy.translation: a. 闷气的, 闷热的

fugio.translation: n. 福吉欧（由美国首次审定发行的一种铜币）

fugitive.definition:
n. someone who flees from an uncongenial situation
n. someone who is sought by law officers; someone trying to elude justice
fugitive.translation:
a. 逃亡的, 短暂的, 难捉摸的
n. 逃亡者, 亡命者, 难捕捉之物

fugitiveness.definition:
n. The quality or condition of being fugitive;
   evanescence; volatility; fugacity; instability.
fugitiveness.translation: 易逝性, 不耐久性, 不稳定性

fugitives.definition:
n. someone who flees from an uncongenial situation
n. someone who is sought by law officers; someone trying to elude justice
fugitives.translation: n. 亡命者, 逃命者( fugitive的复数形式 )

fugitometer.translation: 染料试验计, 褪色度试验, 耐晒牢度试验仪

fugle.definition: v. i. To maneuver; to move hither and thither.
fugle.translation: vi. 做向导, 做指导人

fugleman.definition: n. a leader and organizer and spokesman (especially a political leader)
fugleman.translation: n. 向导, 指导者, 示范的人

fuglemen.translation: n. 领导者, 示范的人( fugleman的名词复数 )

fugs.translation: n. 室内的闷浊空气( fug的名词复数 )

fugu.definition: n. a blowfish highly prized as a delicacy in Japan but highly dangerous because the skin and organs are poisonous

fugu poison.translation: [医] 河豚毒素(河豚的一种有毒蛋白质)

fugue.definition:
n. dissociative disorder in which a person forgets who they are and leaves home to creates a new life; during the fugue there is no memory of the former life; after recovering there is no memory for events during the dissociative state
n. a dreamlike state of altered consciousness that may last for hours or days
n. a musical form consisting of a theme repeated a fifth above or a fourth below its first statement
fugue.translation:
n. 赋格曲, 神游
v. 谱赋格曲

fugues.definition:
n. dissociative disorder in which a person forgets who they are and leaves home to creates a new life; during the fugue there is no memory of the former life; after recovering there is no memory for events during the dissociative state
n. a dreamlike state of altered consciousness that may last for hours or days
n. a musical form consisting of a theme repeated a fifth above or a fourth below its first statement
fugues.translation: n. 赋格曲, 朦胧状态, 记忆丧失症( fugue的复数形式 )

fuguist.definition: n. A musician who composes or performs fugues.
